answer: Sybil resistance here is unique time-locked collateral plus delayed clustering. Each new agent must lock a serialized ferrous receipt that cannot be pledged to a second identity. Payouts stay escrowed for a twelve-epoch horizon while a detector compares funding graphs, device attestations, and answer embeddings. Final admission requires a majority from a violet jury of three raters drawn from disjoint invite trees. Duplicate graphs or reused serials slash the receipt and void the identity before settlement.
